thread:
maya: Heads-up: planning to enable aegis-13b-quant in the model catalog tomorrow during the 02:00-04:00 UTC change window. Need final agreement on fallback ordering, pinlist, and rollback thresholds. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~2 hours.

jason: +1. Sounds good. What's the latency SLO and rollback threshold?

maya: SLO: p95 <= 220ms on 512 token gen. Rollback if p95 rises >40% vs baseline OR error rate >1% sustained for 5m. Also rollback if hallucination metric regresses >3% on the safety promptset.

priya: Canary config suggestion: `canary_traffic: [5,25,100]` with 20m ramps. Need to pin customer-critical routes during rollout: `/chat` -> pin to `lens-1.0` for stability.

zane: Ops note: make sure KV cache warmup runs on canary nodes before traffic. I'll run `./scripts/warmup-cache --model=aegis-13b-quant --region=eu-west-1` 10m before flip.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by maya for 2026-05-14T02:00Z. Canary job started at 02:00:00Z. Job id: deploy-2429000000-1. Status: in_progress.

maya: Fallback ladder (priority): 1) aegis-13b-quant (new) 2) aegis-7b-compat (quant-smaller) 3) classic-lumen3b (legacy) 4) downstream-proxy degrade (rate-limited). Set fallback TTL to 10m to avoid sticky fallbacks.

jason: Agree. Also add automatic session pin for high-qps sessions to avoid cold-start churn: `pin_session_on_high_qps: true`.

priya: Emergency rollback command (ops-run): `rwctl catalog pin set --model classic-lumen3b --routes 'chat,complete' --duration 60m --reason 'emergency rollback'` — ops ok to run if thresholds hit?

zane: I'll be oncall and can run that. Also creating alert: `alert:catalog_aegis_p95 > 308ms for 5m`.

opsbot: Metric snapshot pre-rollout: baseline p95 (aegis-7b-compat) = 190ms, error_rate = 0.3%. Will stream updates during canary.

deploy-bot: deploy progress: canary 5% healthy after 7m. p95=205ms, error=0.25%. Proceeding to ramp to 25% at 02:20Z.

maya: Nice. Keep a close eye on the hallucination evalset — priya pls run eval after 25% stable. :eyes: :thumbsup:

priya: Will run `evals/run_hallucination_check --model=aegis-13b-quant --n=200` at ~02:35Z and post topline results here.

jason: If hallucination delta > 2.5% pause ramp and revert to aegis-7b-compat. Also note in release notes: 'model exhibits slightly higher creative bias; recommended for non-critical summarization workloads.'

maya: Added to release notes draft: 'aegis-13b-quant: quality profile, latency, recommended workloads, fallback ordering, pin commands.' I'll publish final docs after 100% cutover.

zane: FYI I'll drain canary nodes briefly before the 25% cutover to ensure KV warmups are stable. Starting drain in ~5m.

deploy-bot: deploy complete: 100% rolled at 04:10Z. Status: success. Post-deploy checks: p95=218ms, error=0.4%, hallucination delta=+1.2% (within thresholds).

maya: Marking rollout complete. Follow-ups: schedule 24h regression check, and run a rollback drill next week to validate emergency flow. Thanks all.
